documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter
Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Silkflex Polymers held its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call, highlighting the successful commercial production at its Vadodara facility and a transition toward in-house manufacturing. Management reported significant year-on-year revenue and profit growth driven by operational scale, cost control, and backward integration. The company aims to increase manufacturing contribution to 50% of its revenue mix and achieve full capacity utilization by the end of FY2027. Additionally, management addressed strategies regarding raw material volatility, working capital, and product expansion into non-textile segments. Silkflex Polymers reported its Q4 FY26 and full-year FY26 financial performance, highlighting revenue growth and transition from a trading model to manufacturing.

guidance.claim: Management expects full capacity utilization of the Vadodara plant by the end of FY2027.
guidance.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

guidance.claim: The company targets increasing the contribution of manufacturing towards 50% of its revenue mix.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead to FY2027, our priorities remain clear: scaling manufacturing utilization, increasing the contribution of manufacturing towards 50% of our revenue mix, expanding binder sales into non-textile industries as well and deepening our engagement with global brands.

guidance.claim: Overall EBITDA margin can increase by 200 to 300 basis points upon full capacity.
guidance.quote: So overall EBITDA can increase by 200-300 basis points. If seen overall, we can expect expansion by 2% to 3%.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve full capacity by the next financial year.
guidance.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

guidance.claim: Management expects manufacturing margins to reach near about 50% according to the production in coming time.
guidance.quote: Currently our margin in manufacturing is around 25%. And in the coming time, we can expect margins to be near about 50% according to the production.

guidance.claim: Management expects that trading and manufacturing revenues would be equal within 1 and 2 years.
guidance.quote: Yes, that is the question which I am looking that you will you may ask some questions like this. Anyway, but in coming years our trading and manufacturing we are expecting that it would be equal.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates generating around INR70 crores to INR80 crores in total turnover from manufacturing at full utilization.
guidance.quote: It will come to around INR70 crores to INR80 crores.

guidance.claim: Management maintains the guidance to close the year around INR110 crores.
guidance.quote: No, of course the same. These two months, January and February, have also gone well for us.

guidance.claim: Management expects 15% to 20% growth in the textile ink market and 20% to 30% growth in the wood coating market.
guidance.quote: Rohan, now both the segments are growing exceptionally and I am looking for 15% to 20% in the ink market in the textile market, I mean to say. And for the wood coating market it will be more like 20% to 30% in wood coating.

demand_outlook.claim: The near-term export environment remains somewhat cautious due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.
demand_outlook.quote: From a demand standpoint, the near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintain strong sustainable growth supported by rising domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintaining strong sustainable growth supporting by rising the domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: The paints and coating market, particularly water-based and specialty formulations, is witnessing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability performance, prompt technical services, and regulatory preferences.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, the paints and coating market, particularly water-based and speciality formulations, align with our core segments, is witnessing accelerated adoption driven by sustainability performance and prompt technical services as well as regulatory preferences.

demand_outlook.claim: The India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal open significant growth opportunities for Indian textile and furniture exports.
demand_outlook.quote: Thirdly, the recent India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal opens a significant growth opportunities for Indian textile exports as well as furniture exports by eliminating duties on most of the products, narrowing the competitive gap with countries like Bangladesh and Pakistan.

demand_outlook.claim: Global apparel and lifestyle brands are expanding their procurement footprint in India as the country emerges as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing.
demand_outlook.quote: Global apparel and lifestyle brands are expanding their procurement footprint here to ensure reliability, scale, and sustainability.

demand_outlook.claim: Both the textile ink and wood coating segments are growing exceptionally well.
demand_outlook.quote: Rohan, now both the segments are growing exceptionally and I am looking for 15% to 20% in the ink market in the textile market, I mean to say.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is adding new machinery over the next couple of months funded through internal resources.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

capex_expansion.claim: The Vadodara facility is spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet automated setup.
capex_expansion.quote: The Facility is spread over 10 acres of land with 72,000 square feet automated setup and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability which is the first philosophy.

capex_expansion.claim: Further expansion of manufacturing capacity through additional vessels would cost around INR 3 crores to INR 5 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We have furthermore scope of putting up the vessels, which will be costing near about INR3 crore, INR4 crore, INR5 crores, and we can expand our manufacturing capacity as well according to the requirements.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: Commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, marking the company’s strategic shift from trading to a manufacturing-led model to enhance margins, scalability, and operational control.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production has commenced at the first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat, spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet automated plant.
capex_expansion.quote: I am pleased to share that this quarter marks a significant milestone for Silkflex Polymers India Limited with the commencement of commercial production at our first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat. Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

capex_expansion.claim: The facility is designed for further expansion without requiring more capex since utilities, cooling plant, and monomer storage capacity are already installed.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, Ryan. We already set up our factory in a major factors like, you can say utility, cooling plant, monomer storage capacity, already we have been instaledl according to the expansion capacity for the further expansion. So we need not require for more capex.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has planned an expansion within the next 6 months to make domestic binders or inks based on discussions.
capex_expansion.quote: We have planned our expansion within the next 6 months because we will also make domestic binders or based on our discussions, we can also make ink in the coming time.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: With this backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%, reduce our import dependency and enhance supply reliability.

margins_costs.claim: Raw materials saw a sharp increase during the year driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.
margins_costs.quote: To put this in perspective, raw materials saw a sharp increase during the year, largely driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins are around 20% to 25% for the manufacturing segment and 12% to 15% for the trading business.
margins_costs.quote: we can see that the EBITDA margins are around 20%-25% for the manufacturing segment, and for our trading business it is 12% to 15%.

margins_costs.claim: The company transitioned from a trading-led to a manufacturing-led model to strengthen margins, quality control, and supply chain visibility.
margins_costs.quote: Transitioned from a trading-led to a manufacturing-led model, strengthening margins, quality control, and supply chain visibility

margins_costs.claim: Q3 FY26 EBITDA increased by 130.78% year-on-year to INR7.11 crores due to better operating leverage and cost control.
margins_costs.quote: The profitability improved significantly during the quarter with the EBITDA increasing by 130.78% year-on-year to INR7.11 crores. Mainly due to better operating leverage and cost control.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points year-on-year to 21.2% in Q3 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in the quarter 3 from the financial year '25.

margins_costs.claim: Even though manufacturing has started for two products, reliance on imports has reduced by about 10% to 12%.
margins_costs.quote: We are importing wood coating as well. But still, even though manufacturing has started for these two products, our reliance on imports has reduced by about 10% to 12%.

margins_costs.claim: Basic raw material prices at the plant have not seen significant changes in the last 2 years.
margins_costs.quote: In the last 2 years, we haven't seen any significant changes. So, we don't expect too many changes in price movements.

orders_capacity.claim: The plant has an installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability which is the first philosophy.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization stood at approximately 60% in the first year of operations.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization stood at present approximately 60% in the first year of operations and scaling this remains a key priority for FY2027.

orders_capacity.claim: The installed capacity of the new manufacturing facility is 500 tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

orders_capacity.claim: The capacity utilization of the new manufacturing plant was around 60% in the first two months (November and December).
orders_capacity.quote: In first 2 months, that is November and December, after starting the manufacturing, we utilized around 60% capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of the manufacturing capex, INR30 crores is a loan from the bank, and INR20 crores was funded through IPO for land purchase and the rest from internal accruals and unsecured promoter loans.
capital_allocation.quote: Out of that INR30 crores is our loan from the bank and so far as the INR20 crores, it was funded through IPO to purchase the land for INR10 crores and the rest of the amount from internal accrual and unsecured loan from promoters.

capital_allocation.claim: The expected payback period for the INR40 crores investment in the manufacturing plant is around 4 to 5 years.
capital_allocation.quote: You can consider around you may know between 4 to 5 years.

capital_allocation.claim: As of December end, the company's net worth stood at around INR42 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So by December end our net worth stood at around INR42 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to import costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to our import cost.

risks_headwinds.claim: Input costs have remained volatile on the supply side.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the supply side, input costs have remained volatile.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to reach full capacity utilization by the end of financial year '27.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

management_commitments.claim: New machinery will be added over the next couple of months funded through internal resources.
management_commitments.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

management_commitments.quote: By 2030, our vision is to establish Silkflex as a fully integrated, solvent-free, zero-discharge manufacturing company among the most advanced and sustainable players in India's textile and coating solution space.

management_commitments.claim: Trials for non-textile people are ongoing and new products will be launched within a couple of months.
management_commitments.quote: So, hopefully we will be coming soon within couple of months, we will intimate to you once again when we will get through.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets increased sales volume through product portfolio expansion and participation in key industry exhibitions and technical seminars.
management_commitments.quote: Targeting increased sales volume through product portfolio expansion and participation in key industry exhibitions (GMMSA, Knit Show) and technical seminars.

management_commitments.quote: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.

management_commitments.quote: Like 50% import and 50% products we may be manufacturing like that within 1 and 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: The company has planned an expansion within the next 6 months to make domestic binders or inks.
management_commitments.quote: We have planned our expansion within the next 6 months because we will also make domestic binders or based on our discussions, we can also make ink in the coming time.

management_commitments.claim: The expectation is to come to fully manufacturing right now by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: So the expectation is to come to fully manufacturing right now by 2030.
